verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              तस्मिन्निवसमानोऽथ धर्मराजो युधिष्ठिरः। कृष्णया सहितान् भ्रातॄनित्युवाच सहद्विजान्॥१॥
verses.english: Vaishampayana Said When they all living there, Yudhishthira thus spoke to Krishna (Draupadi), his brothers and the Brahmanas.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्टानि तीर्थान्यस्माभिः पुण्यानि च शिवानि च। मनसो ह्लादनीयानि वनानि च पृथक्पृथक्॥२॥
verses.english: "We have alternately soon one after another many sacred and auspicious Tirthas and wood all delightful to look at.

verses.sanskrit: देवैः पूर्वं विचीर्णानि मुनिभिश्च महात्मभिः। यथाक्रमविशेषेण द्विजैः संपूजितानि च॥३॥
verses.english: They had been before visited by the celestials and the high-souled Rishis. They had been worshipped by the Brahmanas.

verses.sanskrit: ऋषीणां पूर्वचरितं तथा कर्म विचेष्टितम्। राजर्षीणां च चरितं कथाश्च विविधाः शुभाः॥४॥
verses.english: We have in various sacred hermitages performed ablutions with the Brahmanas; we have also heard from them the accounts of the) lives and acts of many Rishis and also of many royal sages of yore and also other pleasant stories.

verses.sanskrit: शृण्वानास्तत्र तत्र स्म आश्रमेषु शिवेषु च। अभिषेकं द्विजैः सार्धं कृतवन्तो विशेषतः॥५॥
अर्चिताः सततं देवाः पुष्पैरद्भिः सदा च वः। यथालब्धैर्मूलफलैः पितरश्चापि तर्पिताः॥६॥
verses.english: We have worshipped the celestials with flowers and water, we have offered oblations to the Pitris with fruits and roots as were available there.

verses.sanskrit: पर्वतेषु च रम्येषु सर्वेषु च सरस्सु च। उदधौ च महापुण्ये सूपस्पृष्टं महात्मभिः॥७॥
verses.english: We have with the high-souled Rishis performed our ablutions in all the sacred and beautiful mountains and lakes and also in the highly holy sea.

verses.sanskrit: इला सरस्वती सिन्धुर्यमुना नर्मदा तथा। नानातीर्थेषु रम्येषु सूपस्पृष्टं सह द्विजैः॥८॥
verses.english: We have with the Brahmanas bathed in the Ila, in the Sarasvati, in the Sindhu, in the Yamuna, in the Narmada and in various other charming Tirthas.

verses.sanskrit: गङ्गाद्वारमतिक्रम्य बहवः पर्वताः शुभाः। हिमवान् पर्वतश्चैव नानाद्विजगणायुतः॥९॥
verses.english: Having passed the source of the Ganges, we have seen many charming mountains and also the Himalayas, inhabited by various kinds of birds;

verses.sanskrit: विशाला बदरी दृष्टा नरनारायणाश्रमः। दिव्या पुष्करिणी दृष्टा सिद्धदेवर्षिपूजिता॥१०॥
verses.english: And also the great Badari, where there is the herinitage of Nara and Narayana. We have seen the celestials lake adored by the Siddhas and he celestials Rishis.

verses.sanskrit: यथाक्रमविशेषेण सर्वाण्यायतनानि च। दर्शितानि द्विजश्रेष्ठा लोमशेन महात्मना॥११॥
verses.english: O foremost of Brahmanas, we have one after the other seen all the celebrated and sacred places with the high souled Lomasha.

verses.sanskrit: इमं वैश्रवणावासं पुण्यं सिद्धनिषेवितम्। कथं भीम गमिष्यामो गतिरन्प्तरधीयताम्॥१२॥
verses.english: O Bhima, now we shall go to the yonder abode of Vaisravana (Kubera) frequented by the Siddhas. Think of the means of entering it."

verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              एवं ब्रुवति राजेन्द्रे वागुवाचाशरीरिणी। न शक्यो दुर्गमो गन्तुमितो वैश्रवणाश्रमात्॥१३॥
verses.english: When that king of kings had said this, an invisible voice spoke thus, “You will not be able to go to the inaccessible abode of Vaisravana.
verses.bhavadeepa: गतिरन्तरधीयताम् - अन्तर्गतिः कुबेरभवने प्रवेशः कथं भवेदित्यधीयतां विचार्यताम् ॥१२॥

verses.sanskrit: अनेनैव पथा राजन् प्रतिगच्छ यथागतम्। नरनारायणस्थानं बदरीत्यभिविश्रुतम्॥१४॥
verses.english: By this way, O king, go back from this place to the place whence you have come, to the hermitage of Nara Narayana which is called Badari.

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद्यास्यसि कौन्तेय सिद्धचारणसेवितम्। बहुपुष्पफलं रम्यमाश्रमं वृषपर्वणः॥१५॥
verses.english: O son of Kunti, from that place you will go to the hermitage of Vrishaparva abounding in flowers and fruits and frequented by the Siddhas and the Charanas,

verses.sanskrit: अतिक्रम्य च तं पार्थ त्वार्ष्टिषेणाश्रमे वसेः। ततो द्रक्ष्यसि कौन्तेय निवेशं धनदस्य च॥१६॥
verses.english: O son of Pritha, having passed it, you will go to the hermitage of Arshnisena and O son of Kunti, from that place you will see the abode of Kubera."

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे वायुर्दिव्यगन्धवहः शुचिः। सुखप्रह्लादनः शीतः पुण्यवर्षं ववर्ष च॥१७॥
verses.english: Just as that moment the breeze became fresh, charming, cool and full of celestials fragrance and it showered flowers.

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वा तु दिव्यामाकाशाद्वाचं सर्वे विसिस्मियुः। ऋषीणां ब्राह्मणानां च पार्थिवानां विशेषतः॥१८॥
verses.english: On hearing the celestials voice in the sky they were all surprised, more specially the Rishis and Brahmanas (who were with the Pandavas).

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वा तन्महदाश्चर्यं द्विजो धौम्योऽब्रवीत्तदा। न शक्यमुत्तरं वक्तुमेवं भवतु भारत॥१९॥
verses.english: On hearing this great wonder, the Brahmana Dhaumya said, "O descendant of Bharata, this should not be gain said. Let this be so."

verses.sanskrit: ततो युधिष्ठिरो राजा प्रतिजग्राह तद्वचः। प्रत्यागम्य पुनस्तं तु नरनारायणाश्रमम्॥२०॥
verses.english: Thereupon the king Yudhishthira accepted his words. Having returned to the hermitage of Nara and Narayana,

verses.sanskrit: भीमसेनादिभिः सर्वैर्भ्रातृभिः परिवारितः। पाञ्चाल्या ब्राह्मणाश्चैव न्यवसन्त सुखं तदा॥२१॥
verses.english: He happily lived there surrounded by Bhimasena and his other brothers and also by the Panchala princess and the Brahmanas.
